articles.title: Ethereum Price Prediction: ETH Bull Flag Targets $3,050 as Remittix’s Upgraded Dashboard Sends RTX Demand Higher
articles.description: Ethereum’s break above its bull-flag formation has produced a technical target near $3,050. ETH recently traded around $2,688 after clearing resistance at $2,661, while the 2,825 region may become an intermediate consolidation zone before another attempt higher.

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds strongly this week, trades near $84,000 after climbing above $86,000. Here is what experts say
articles.description: Bitcoin rebounded to around $84,000 after briefly crossing $86,000, while Ethereum traded near $2,688. Bitcoin gained 3.6% weekly, supported by positive ETF flows and reduced uncertainty after the US Federal Reserves September policy decision, though markets remain in consolidation overall.

articles.title: ARK partners with Securitize to put a venture fund on Ethereum, but leaves exit doors locked
articles.description: ARK Invest has brought tokenized interests in ARKVX to Ethereum, with a Sept. 30 repurchase deadline, a 5% quarterly buyback cap and no announced secondary market.

articles.title: NFT sales rise 57.17% to $55.5M as Ethereum leads
